question.prompt: Reducing the algebraic fraction \(4x^2y/(6xy^2)\) gives \(2x/(ky)\). What is \(k\)? (Both \(x\) and \(y\) are nonzero.)

solutions.explanation: Divide both the numerator and denominator by the common factor \(2xy\): \(4x^2y/(2xy)=2x\) and \(6xy^2/(2xy)=3y\). Therefore, \(k=3\).
solutions.title: Cancel the common factor 2xy
